title: hypericum annulatum subsp. intermedium
intro: Hypericum annulatum subsp. intermedium, commonly known as a species of St. John's Wort, is a plant native to the Balkan Peninsula. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include treating anxiety, insomnia, and mild depression, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to exhibit sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, making it a popular choice for treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, such as hyperforin and hypericin.
